eoe.text: The Dawnsire is a Sunstar Free Company dreadnought carrying a weapon meant to turn Sothera back into a real sun, and Monoists attacked it with inevitors that were to hit at thirty kilometers a second.
On its bridge, Captain Slats phorocast that Vondam would die in the battle, and Vondam closed his helmet and told Haliya to look to the Sum before facing the attack.
The inevitor struck the Dawnsire and deployed a cherazad that suspended most of the impact, then the Monoist boarders overwhelmed the Sunstar defenders and pushed down the ship, burning a basilica.

Alpharael threw away his singularity bead to kill his foe, and the newborn microvoid passed through Vondam's head; Slats sentenced Alpharael to live, and Vondam was later revealed alive with a pinhead hole through his head.
